info.name: Digital Wallet & Transaction Processing Platform
info.description: Run folder 'Quick Start' top-to-bottom (Collection Runner / Newman) for a self-asserting end-to-end demo. The 'Reference' folders contain every endpoint with example bodies; set `accessToken` (from POST /api/auth/login) to call them.
